verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents a speed-oriented 'Fast' partitioning strategy alongside High Res and VLM, and an Auto mode that routes pages to balance quality, speed, and cost (docs-10, docs-24). The Python SDK and REST API can partition files directly (docs-23, docs-30), but the documented API flows are job-based, with runs triggered and results downloaded later (docs-5, docs-35). Nothing shows a synchronous call that returns results in seconds, and no latency is documented for any mode. Missing for 10: an explicitly synchronous low-latency endpoint, documented per-mode latency figures, and independent or hands-on corroboration of response times.
